# MockTestVault — Full Resource and Editorial Reference

## Platform scope
MockTestVault is an independent browser-based examination practice platform. It provides timed multiple-choice tests, sectional drills, revision sheets and local progress tracking for selected examinations. Its interface uses common computer-based testing conventions. It is not official examination software and does not administer or register candidates for any examination.

## Data and editorial limitations
The current site release contains 6,404 question records across 286 question-data JSON files (287 JSON files in the release including the web manifest). The code validates JSON syntax, required fields, option arrays, answer-index ranges and the presence of explanation fields. These checks do not establish factual correctness. The full bank has not been independently re-solved by qualified subject-matter reviewers.

A total of 954 records are associated with SSC CGL 2023 shift labels or CBSE 2023/2024 year labels. The original papers/response sheets and official final answer keys have not been supplied and matched item by item. These collections are independent year/shift-labelled practice sets, not authenticated verbatim previous-year questions.

Question citation fields may identify a textbook chapter, syllabus topic, examination standard or authority landing page. Such references provide context only. Unless an exact source URL and page/question/shift locator are present and matched, they do not prove official paper provenance or answer-key agreement.

A normalized cross-file comparison identified 1,102 repeated question-stem groups and 1,261 additional occurrences. It also marked 10 groups where selected-answer text differs between instances and 77 groups where explanation text differs. The answer-text flags can arise from changes in options or wording; they require human inspection and are not confirmed errors. Duplicate questions are retained where use across a chapter drill and a full mock is intentional.

The v2.9 registers are workflow aids. Blank reviewer and evidence fields must be completed by a human reviewer. Never describe a pending record as verified merely because it passes structural or overlap checks.

## CBSE Class 10 practice catalogue
The Class 10 catalogue lists 48 independent practice modules across 13 Science, 14 Mathematics and 21 Social Science chapter pages. It also provides selected formula/revision sheets and independent 80-mark/3-hour practice modules. This inventory does not certify full alignment with every 2026–27 syllabus update, and the year-labelled 2023/2024 sets are not authenticated original board papers.

For the current academic session, use the official CBSE resources first:
- Curriculum for 2026–27: https://cbseacademic.nic.in/curriculum_2027.html
- Class X sample question papers and marking schemes for 2026–27: https://cbseacademic.nic.in/sqp_classx_2026-27.html
- CBSE circular Acad-14/2026: https://www.cbse.gov.in/cbsenew/documents/14_Circular_01042026.pdf

MockTestVault's navigation page for these sources and the suggested practice workflow is https://mocktestvault.com/cbse-class-10/2026-27-syllabus-sample-papers.html.

## SSC CGL practice catalogue
The SSC CGL hub provides independent Tier-I practice mocks and subject drills. The 2026 notification structure describes 25 questions per subject across Reasoning, General Awareness, Quantitative Aptitude and English Comprehension, 50 marks per subject, 60 minutes overall with 15-minute sectional timers, and a 0.50-mark penalty per wrong answer. Practice scorecards are not SSC results; official notices control if the scheme changes. Official portal: https://ssc.gov.in/.

## Privacy and browser storage
Bookmarks, local preferences, and test attempt history are stored in browser storage on the user's device. The site uses a custom analytics-consent interface; Google Analytics is loaded only after the visitor explicitly accepts analytics. The custom banner is not represented as a Google-certified/IAB TCF CMP.
